title: The Letter to the Hebrews, Every Word
hand: Better than the angels, better than Moses.
intro: A home base for the Every Word channel's verse-by-verse series through Hebrews. Each card is one video from the series, in teaching order (the playlist itself lists the newest video first). When a study page is ready, the card turns teal and opens it: summary, Old Testament connections, people, places, map, timeline, word studies and questions, with Scripture linked to the LSB, key names linked to the Logos Factbook, and a full-color PDF for Goodnotes.
note: The series is still being released, so the total grows as new videos come out. Passages: built episodes show the verses the video reads; cards still to come say only Hebrews until their study page is written.
foot: Video titles from the Every Word playlist (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEje06qXea_0), listed oldest first. Scripture links open the Legacy Standard Bible at read.lsbible.org.
